description.p: Mini Downloader is a lightweight native download manager powered by aria2 and yt-dlp. It supports segmented downloads, torrents, media capture, scheduling, categories, and an optional browser connector.

Safer, tidier downloads: files are staged and never overwritten, browser cookies stay on their origin across redirects, plus file-type icons, drag-out to other apps, and single-click select with double-click open. The database is upgraded and cannot be opened by 3.2.0 afterwards.
